draftUse.basis: Validated identity/reuse and matched measurement rules

applicabilityReason: Variable-capacity (n=1..4) overlapping-AST routing, 8-codebook invariance, and 29404-settle execution require explicit identity and evidence accounting.

selectedRules.applicabilityReason: Shared native 56-source reuse, variable-capacity candidate/leaf slot routing, and capacity-stratified envelope indexing require full source/role/revision/config binding without host truth repair.
Information-matched exact control and complete accounting of source, role, transfer envelope, upper pipeline, storage, audit, and seal costs without efficiency overclaims.

facts.statement: R35 tested feasible1..4 and query1..4 under mutually exclusive leaves that collapsed the 6 ASTs to 3/6-5/6 functions (with AST 2 producing 0 feasible solutions) and omitted n=1(complete=True) and n=4(complete=False). R36, R44, and R45 restricted overlapping-leaf and 8-codebook testing to n=2, complete=True only, and R46 relational consumer used only feasible2.

R35 equality(cfg) partitions 64 ordered 3-bit inputs into 4 Hamming equivalence classes d in {0,1,2,3}, feeding 6x4^3=384 exhaustive expr settles. Across capacities n in {1,2,3,4}, feasible_n has C(n,2) in {0,1,3,6} pairwise inhibition nodes (pair_i_j -> at_least_two) with 2^{n+1} Boolean corners (4+8+16+32=60), and query_n has 2^{2n+1} Boolean corners (8+32+128+512=680) driven by capacity-stratified inner-margin [false_max, true_min] bounds.

56 lower sources + 1188 stage-transfer settles (64 role + 384 expr + 60 feasible1..4 + 680 query1..4) + 28160 upper settles across n in {1,2,3,4} (320x10 + 320x18 + 320x26 + 320x34) = 29404 native settles (+ 160 exact = 1440 evaluations, 18 batches x 80). 600s total / 240s stage / raw 128MiB / cache 128MiB / AS 512MiB / worker 1 / retry 0.

invariants.statement: Only token-to-code map and grounded 56-source 8-token inputs across capacities n in {1,2,3,4} and complete in {True,False} are supplied to unchanged R35 execute; core/learner/AST/Config/initial 0.5/guards/controller/history/Cost are unchanged. Every one of the 160 base cases must induce 8/8 distinct restricted maps (0 unchanged pairs), each codebook must exercise all 64 ordered code pairs, and each capacity n in {1..4} must realize 6/6 distinct AST functions.
invariants.scope: R47 56 sources / 160 base across n=1..4 (8/8 restricted classes, 64/64 code pairs, 6/6 ASTs per n) / 1188 transfer / 29404 settles

invariants.statement: 64 actual role inputs partition into 4 exact Hamming distance classes d in {0,1,2,3}; 384 expr settles exhaust all 6x4^3 Hamming-triple drives for all 40320 bijections at the expr stage; 60 feasible1..4(4+8+16+32) and 680 query1..4(8+32+128+512) settles audit the capacity-stratified [false_max, true_min] extremal scalar bounds across n=1..4 without claiming 64^n enumeration. Full 1280 native + 160 exact + 1120 paired semantic invariance across none/unique/many(|F|=2,3,4)/incomplete and qtrue/qfalse/mixed/empty/incomplete, plus stage-by-stage tick attribution, replayed from saved traces; 25 mutations rejected.
invariants.scope: R47 56 sources / 160 base across n=1..4 (8/8 restricted classes, 64/64 code pairs, 6/6 ASTs per n) / 1188 transfer / 29404 settles

invariants.statement: 29404 actual settles (29348 recorded + 56 sources) / max 4704640 ticks / fixed stage 240s total 600s / worker 1 retry 0 / raw 128MiB / cache 128MiB / AS 512MiB each / record 128KiB / unique 6000. Full physical ref ledger and all phase/parent/launcher CPU and wall observed; storage-only dedup never skips computation; no speed or learning cost adoption claim. Direct size/SHA of all raw and source pins.
invariants.scope: R47 56 sources / 160 base across n=1..4 (8/8 restricted classes, 64/64 code pairs, 6/6 ASTs per n) / 1188 transfer / 29404 settles

designChoices.statement: Construct 40 base cases per capacity n in {1,2,3,4} (24 Part I ASTxcomplementary-mask + 8 Part II multi-solution/query regimes + 8 Part III complete=False abstention = 160 base cases) with distinguishing token cohorts and separate 1188 stage-transfer settles (64 role + 384 expr + 60 feasible1..4 + 680 query1..4).
designChoices.rationale: Guarantees 8/8 restricted maps per base, 64/64 ordered pairs per map, 6/6 distinct ASTs per capacity n=1..4, and complete coverage of |F| in {0..4}, unanimous/split query, and incomplete abstention within 29404 settles.

verificationObligations.failureOracle: nonbijection/unknown token accepted; restricted map classes < 8; ordered code pairs < 64; AST functions < 6 per capacity; AST/drive repair; source/role/config drift; hidden oracle consumer

role Hamming classes not exact within tolerance; expr 384 transfer failure; feasible1..4 (60) or query1..4 (680) extremal envelope failure; 64^n overclaim; selected-code compared instead of identity; incomplete policy bypass; scalar tolerance used as meaning oracle
